Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ggPSE 0.3.2

  • New ggPSE_symbols() marks elements by category with point symbols: up to six categories and four per elements. # ggPSE 0.3.0
  • New symbol_position argument in ggPSE() and ggPSE_interactive() to draw the element symbol at the "center", "top", "bottom", "left" or "right" of each tile.
  • New ggPSE_symbols() marks elements by category with point symbols: up to six categories (at most four per element), one pch and colour each. The markers sit in one row at the very bottom of the tile, placed by the measured size of their shapes (equal gaps, centred, one common bottom line), while the element symbol and value move up. A white edge keeps them visible on coloured tiles (halo = TRUE/FALSE), and a legend is added.
  • New symbol_position argument in ggPSE() and ggPSE_interactive() to draw the element symbol at the "center", "top", "bottom", "left" or "right" of each tile.
  • New number_position argument to place the atomic number at any of the eight border positions of the tile.
  • New symbol_size argument to set the symbol size independently of base_size.
  • New ggPSE_text() adds a line of text per tile from a data column (positions "top", "center", "bottom", plus a fine-tuning position_nudge).
  • New symbol_nudge and number_nudge arguments shift the symbol / atomic number.
  • New label_na argument and text_color in ggPSE() and ggPSE_interactive().
  • highlight now also accepts a named list of symbol vectors, e.g. highlight = split(df$symbol, df$category), with the new highlight_colors argument (named or by position).
  • ggPSE_theme() no longer removes your colour scales
  • Redesigned "publication" theme for print
  • Data check for given data to ggPSE(), ggPSE_interactive(), ggPSE_bubble(), ggPSE_bar() and ggPSE_profile() for typos, spaces, etc.
  • A value column named atomic_number, col or row no longer clashes with the internal tile table
  • ggPSE_bubble() without size_col draws a blank table instead of failing.
  • README: fixed typos gPSE_donut and ggpse_elemts.
  • ggPSE_bar(): bars now start at zero by default, so their length is proportional to the value
  • The element tables are lazy-loaded (LazyData: true): ggpse_elements and ggpse_grid are available after library(ggPSE)
  • ggPSE_badge(): badge_size was multiplied by 0.22
  • ggPSE_profile() gives a clear error if period or group is not a single number.
  • Documentation: tile_border no longer claims to detect the background.
  • Colours: ggPSE() and ggPSE_interactive() have new arguments colors (two or more colours), midpoint (diverging scales), limits (a fixed colour range, e.g. for the frames of an animation), breaks and labels, so the fill scale no longer has to be replaced afterwards. The text colour of each tile is now chosen against the colour the tile really gets Fills are unchanged - in the default gradient the symbol colour changes on a few tiles where it was wrong (4 of 87 in the electronegativity example).
  • text_color can now name a column in data with one colour per element.
  • Text layout is now defined in one internal helper shared by ggPSE() and ggPSE_interactive().
  • Documentation fix: base_size default is 10, not 8.

ggPSE 0.2.0

  • Added selection parameters for ggPSE()
  • New ggPSE_profile() to plot alongside groups or periods identifying trends.
  • Added interactivity using ggiraph
  • Updated the license to MIT.
  • Added a possible hierarchy for ggPSE_badge() and optional legend
  • Added ggPSE_theme wrapper for ease of publishing
  • ggPSE_save() for ease of use

ggPSE 0.1.0

  • Initial release
